svg.title: FlashSystem in three of IBM's figures
svg.desc: 11.8 PBe of effective capacity in one 2U enclosure. Zero downtime when data moves between FlashSystem arrays, guaranteed under IBM Storage Assurance Perpetual. 5,500 write cycles for FlashCore Module 4 drives, against about 1,000 for industry-standard QLC drives.
